authorization: Explicit delegated instruction authorizes sanitized report/evidence/hash publication to this case unique run path; no raw conversation published
publicationMethod: append-only tree based on freshly observed evidence head; non-force fast-forward ref update; if concurrent race re-read head and rebase only new run files
rollback: Preserve before/after immutable commits; if correction needed append new corrective report or revert only this run addition on fresh evidence head. No reset or force push.
privacyReview: allowlisted derived JSON/Markdown only, fixed public benchmark prompt referenced/quoted; no environment dumps, secret/placeholder values, raw private host logs or raw chat
